﻿menuTypes:
  main:
    defaultColourScheme: main-menu
    defaultBorderScheme: main-menu
    defaultHeaderStyle: header
    defaultHeaderColourScheme: header
    defaultHeaderBorderScheme: main-menu
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    defaultItemType: action

  settings:
    defaultColourScheme: settings-menu
    defaultBorderScheme: settings-menu
    defaultHeaderStyle: header
    defaultHeaderColourScheme: header
    defaultHeaderBorderScheme: settings-menu
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    defaultItemType: toggle

  admin:
    defaultColourScheme: admin-menu
    defaultBorderScheme: default
    defaultHeaderStyle: header
    defaultHeaderColourScheme: header
    defaultHeaderBorderScheme: default
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    defaultItemType: action

menuItemTypes:
  action:
    defaultColourScheme: primary-action
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    behaviourFlags:
      - executable
      - routable

  navigate:
    defaultColourScheme: navigation-item
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    behaviourFlags:
      - routable

  toggle:
    defaultColourScheme: accent-toggle
    defaultSelectionMethod: toggle
    behaviourFlags:
      - stateful

  slider:
    defaultColourScheme: slider-item
    defaultSelectionMethod: slider
    behaviourFlags:
      - continuous

  carousel:
    defaultColourScheme: carousel-item
    defaultSelectionMethod: carousel
    behaviourFlags:
      - cyclical

  static:
    defaultColourScheme: neutral-static
    defaultSelectionMethod: none
    behaviourFlags:
      - informational

  header:
    defaultColourScheme: header-item
    defaultSelectionMethod: none
    behaviourFlags:
      - noninteractive

  menu:
    defaultColourScheme: menu-item
    defaultSelectionMethod: number
    behaviourFlags:
      - navigable
